audit.why: 51.47% over 9001 games. Syndra owns levels 1-4 on combo threat, Ahri takes 6 and first item on Spirit Rush, Syndra retakes two-items on Unleashed Power range. Even, 5.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text repeated the false range claim and never named the cooldowns that gate her burst (E 15s flat, W 12/11/10/9/8, R 120/100/80).
audit.why: Scatter the Weak at a flat 15s is the longest cooldown in the lane and the entire all-in window.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written into spikes[0] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: FACTUAL ERROR repeated in whys[0], early, spikes[0] and wants.foe[0]: 'Syndra's Q has more base range than your Orb of Deception'. Dark Sphere is 800; Ahri's Q is 970. Also wants.you[1] calls the stun 'her stun (W)' — the stun is Scatter the Weak (E); W is Force of Will.
audit.why: Riot data: Syndra Q 800, W 925, E 650, R 675; Ahri Q 970, E 975. Ahri out-ranges every Syndra ability except Force of Will, and even that is shorter than her orb.
audit.corrected: Range facts corrected everywhere and the stun re-slotted to E.

audit.whatIsWrong: No note that MR is the wrong buy.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule resistances-invalidated: Transcendent upgrades Force of Will to deal bonus true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: all seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' while win[] reads Syndra x4, Ahri, Ahri, Syndra. Ratings were flat 5/10 and 6/10 against that split.
audit.why: win[] matches packet.levelChart, so the full layer is the wrong one.
audit.corrected: phases sides flipped to match win[] as one atomic group; ratings aligned to the same split.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0].d was a generic template unrelated to its own title.
audit.why: Spirit Rush is the dodge tool for her sphere combo, so spending it on spacing is the actual mistake.

edits.before: Syndra's Q has more base range than your Orb of Deception, letting her poke and zone you off the wave without taking any risk.
edits.after: Her Dark Sphere reaches 800 to your orb's 970, but Force of Will throws it 925 and slows, so she zones with the sphere she already placed.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are rough — Syndra's Q has more range than your Orb of Deception and she can safely poke you off the minion wave without taking risk, and this only gets worse through level 5 once her full combo (Q-W-E-stun) threatens to delete you in a single rotation.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are rough, but not on range — your orb reaches 970 to her Dark Sphere's 800. It is Force of Will at 925 that pokes you off the wave, and by level 5 a sphere plus Scatter the Weak stuns you into a full rotation that can delete you outright.

edits.before: Syndra's Q-W-E stun combo one-shots squishy lane opponents once she has all three abilities, and her longer base range than your Q means she poke-wins if you try to farm at range.
edits.after: Syndra's Q-W-E one-shots squishies once all three are up: Scatter the Weak stuns anything her Dark Sphere hits, and E is 15s at every rank — the longest window in her kit.

edits.before: Zone you off the wave with superior base Q range and safe poke
edits.after: Zone you off the wave with Force of Will throws and stacked spheres

edits.before: Bait out her stun (W) on a minion or ward before engaging
edits.after: Bait Scatter the Weak (E, 15s) onto a minion before you commit

edits.before: Q both ways through the wave on his last-hits — the true-damage return is most of your early poke.
edits.after: Q both ways through the wave on her last-hits — your orb's 970 out-ranges Dark Sphere's 800 outright.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Spirit Rush (last dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak is 15s at every rank — the longest cooldown in her kit and the only thing that stuns you. Step up the moment it misses. - Force of Will is 12s at rank 1, and its upgraded true damage means MR won't save you; buy health instead. - Bank your last Spirit Rush dash for her Unleashed Power.

edits.before: Carry through picks — a landed charm is a won fight, and your dashes manufacture charm angles no one wards against.
edits.after: Carry through picks — charm her out of Scatter the Weak's range and Syndra has no dash and no escape at all.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt the map: shove with Q, dash-flank every river, and charm-pick Syndra's teammates until the lane lead is a game lead.
edits.after: Ahead, shove with Q and roam: Syndra has no dash, so she can't follow, and her sphere zoning means nothing to a lane she isn't in.

edits.before: Q through his last-hit so both hits land, W if he eats the return, and walk — repeat until the charm window is lethal instead of optimistic.
edits.after: Q through her last-hit so both hits land, W the return, and step out of Scatter the Weak's 650 range before she can place a sphere on you.

edits.before: That’s Syndra’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Spirit Rush dodges her sphere combo — spent on spacing it hands her the stun.

notes: The 'Syndra out-ranges your Q' claim was false and had propagated into four fields (whys[0], early, spikes[0], wants.foe[0]) — Dark Sphere is 800, Ahri Q is 970. The stun was also mis-slotted to W in wants.you[1]. suspectNames flagged 'Save Unleashed Power' — that is a FALSE POSITIVE, Unleashed Power is the correct R name. Did not assert whether charm can interrupt Unleashed Power's cast or whether tenacity shortens the sphere stun — not in the kit text. | COHERENCE: 4 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
